findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body:
`MetricAlertDetectorHandler` now subclasses `StatefulDetectorHandler` but its body is just `pass`. It implements none of the abstract members: `counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and the new `build_occurrence_and_event_data`.

`MetricAlertFire.detector_handler` points at this class. `Detector.detector_handler` calls `group_type.detector_handler(self)`, so any `metric_alert_fire` detector will raise `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class` when accessed. Inside `process_detectors` that exception propagates and aborts processing for every detector in the batch.

Previously the handler implemented `evaluate` and safely returned an empty result. Either keep a concrete stub implementing the abstract methods, or keep the old `DetectorHandler` subclass until the real implementation exists.

findings.title: Docstring still says evaluate returns a list
findings.body: The `StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate` docstring still says it "returns a list of `DetectorEvaluationResult`". After this change it returns a dict keyed by `DetectorGroupKey`, so the docstring misleads implementers and callers about the return type.
